name: Lukas Geyer
tagline: Semestra, Paradeiser and Muninn: calm, private apps for studying, built by Lukas Geyer.
intro: I build calm, private apps for studying: Semestra plans your study time around your lectures, Paradeiser keeps you focused in intervals, and Muninn will help you remember. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

newsletter.heading: Letters & New Stories
newsletter.description: Receive new short stories, longform essays, and occasional Semestra release notes by email.
newsletter.footnote: Sent only when something new is published. Unsubscribe anytime.

semestra.name: Semestra
semestra.subtitle: Study Planner for iPhone & iPad
semestra.summary: Semestra turns your university timetable into a study plan: it finds the free time between your lectures, spreads the study time for each exam until exam day, and adjusts by itself when something moves.
semestra.pricing: Free · Semestra Plus arrives with version 2.0

paradeiser.name: Paradeiser
paradeiser.subtitle: Interval Focus Timer for iPhone & iPad
paradeiser.summary: Paradeiser is a calm interval timer for focused study and work: set your focus blocks and breaks, follow along on the Lock Screen, and grow a tomato for every round you finish.

muninn.name: Muninn
muninn.subtitle: Spaced-Repetition Flashcards Built on Rust & FSRS-7
muninn.summary: A spaced-repetition flashcard app as capable as Anki without being a clone of it: one shared Rust core with an FSRS-7 scheduler and lossless Anki deck import, wrapped in fast native apps starting with iOS and macOS.
muninn.platforms: iOS · macOS first · Android and desktop planned
muninn.pricing: Free on every platform · Optional Plus tier
